title: Source ownership
responsibility: Shows owned paths, symbols, execution targets and actual archived code at the selected revision.

inputs.name: EntitySource.unit
inputs.description: Required unit with owned files/symbols, runtime targets, identity and version.

inputs.name: EntitySource.mediaBase
inputs.description: Existing authorized media route prefix for this history.

inputs.name: EntitySource.commit
inputs.description: Commit that archived these files, including a removed entity’s last retained revision.

outputs.name: EntitySource
outputs.description: Ownership details plus the shared source reader. Files are fetched only from validated content-addressed media references; older histories and unreadable files state explicit gaps.
